limitations: This is common-input downstream projection/routing measurement, with reconstructed public records. It does not reproduce original provenance-backed answer verification, lineage, retention, source archive or replay.

Exact JSON provider responses are coupled across corresponding opposite-arm request occurrences within one case/repetition/stage; these are not independent arm samples or an overall accuracy/noninferiority estimate. Physical versus coupled usage must remain separate.

The summarizer automatic evidence-loss guard detects nonempty-to-empty, not every partial line loss. The stronger no-eligible-content-loss conclusion is independently checked on this fixed offline matrix.

Preserved failed/partial experiments must remain visible and cannot be summarized as complete. Completed main answers are checkpointed immediately; a preceding recall or factual context can still be absent from its partial checkpoint if the next suboperation throws.
Live source-based semantic adjudication is still required. Eligible-context availability must not be represented as answer correctness. Original failed full gate and archived grades remain unchanged.
